_doc: analysis/gripper/camera.py output. Tags: S sourced, D derived (this script), A assumed. Frame: MuJoCo world of so101_old_calib.xml (mm).

exposure_lit_ms.note: with a 5-10 W LED work light on the bed

seam_allowance_mm.note: 5/8 in seam-guide line right of the needle (common domestic default)

presser_foot_front_mm.note: foot toe ahead of the needle

needle_reach_mm.note: needle at 325 mm from the pan axis along the tension line (R24: reach <= 300 at the gripper)

feed_travel_mm.note: gripper travel along the feed while holding (duty cycle 20 s x 10 mm/s = 200 mm; trimmed to 150 mm so IK holds 45 deg tilt inside the reach window; longer seams re-grip)

tilt_deg.note: gripper within 45 deg of straight down (params.json work_cell.gripper_tilt_max_deg); nail finger lower

pad_above_bed_mm.note: cloth lifted 4 mm into the pinch so the tip clears the bed

approach_backoff_mm.note: approach pose: jaw open +20 deg, 15 mm back along the finger axis

px_per_mm_req.note: edge located to +-0.5 mm with >= 2.5 px per 0.5 mm band (brief)

critical_len_mm.note: edge segment just ahead of the presser foot = next 4 s of seam at 10 mm/s

cable_carried_m.note: cable length whose weight hangs on the gripper before the first tie-down on the lower arm

mount_fill.note: 40 % infill + walls, effective solid fraction (upstream README prints the adapter at 40 %)

wrist_self_clear_housing_mm.note: camera board + plate envelope to housing solids and pad/flange stack

wrist_self_clear_fingers_mm.note: camera envelope to the finger/knuckle sweep, theta_min .. +20 deg

camera_body_radius_mm.note: fixed cameras: 32 x 32 board + lens barrel half-diagonal

clearance_req_mm.note: running clearance to arm links, gripper and bed

wrist_clear_arm_links_mm.note: wrist camera envelope to SO-101 link meshes: task poses + roll sweep -150..150 deg at mid-feed; the folded approach pose's roll sweep is reported, not gated

mount._doc: Numbers the CAD rebuild uses. Gripper local frame: c = jaw closing axis (+ toward finger B, the upper/idler finger), u = roll axis from the gripper-body origin toward the tips, n = gear-axis direction (+ = front-plate side, which faces the seam edge; servo body on -n). Machine frame: origin at the needle point on the bed, a = operator's right (toward the tower), b = along the feed, z = up from the bed.

camera_plate.holes: 4x dia 2.2 (M2) on 21.0 x 12.5 mm centres, 2.0 mm in from the edges, board 25 x 23.86 mm
camera_plate.tag: S Camera Module 2 mechanical drawing (https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/camera/camera-module-2-mechanical-drawing.pdf); RPi docs: CM3 board and holes identical to CM2 (https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/accessories/camera.html)

primary_fixed.hardware: desk clamp + 1/4-20 ball head on a 12-15 mm rod or 2020 extrusion post, fixed to the table (not the machine: needle vibration); printed camera plate 28 x 26.9 x 2.5 mm with 4x M2 on 21.0 x 12.5 mm centres (Pi Camera 3 board 25 x 23.86, holes dia 2.2) and a 1/4-20 insert on its back; lock the pose with thread-locker, then run one homography to the bed
primary_fixed.calibration: intrinsics (checkerboard) + planar homography to the bed plane, re-done if the clamp moves

head_thresholds_M_C1.rule: critical edge >= 90 % visible at every feed pose; 2 mm steps; the other head faces at nominal

backup_fixed.hardware: small bracket on a printed foot clipped to the bed front-right, inside the throat under the machine arm; keep clear of the presser-foot lever and the hand wheel side
backup_fixed.note: UVC 32 x 32 here rests on assumed specs (1080p, 90 deg, 3 um; a 720p module drops to about 3.9 px/mm); the OV9281 (global shutter, sourced 1280 x 800) passes on a sourced resolution with an assumed lens

wrist_option.plate_orientation: camera plate stands 80.8 deg to the flange; its normal (the optical axis) is 9.2 deg from +u toward -n; board edge nearest the lens faces -n (toward the housing; the FFC/USB exits there)

camera_plate.holes: 4x M2 on a 27.0 mm square (D, measured from the upstream 32x32 wrist-mount STEP)
camera_plate.tag: S 32 x 32 board (SO-101 README); lens centred and 15 mm depth A

pad_on_housing.bolt_pattern: 2x M3 at 8.1 mm along u (upstream Hex-Nut adapter spacing, D9) at (c, u) = [(11.0, 22.95), (11.0, 31.05)]
pad_on_housing.fastening: blind bore dia 4.2 x 4.5 deep from the boss top for a short M3 heat-set insert <= 4.0 mm long; M3 x 6 screws through the 3 mm flange (3 mm engagement). No inside hex-nut trap: the inside face of the front plate is 1 mm above the gear faces
pad_on_housing.placement_reason: off the gear pitch point (c 0, u 40.7) and clear of the dia 9 lightening hole at (c 0, u 29.7)
pad_on_housing.deviation_from_D9: D9 names hex-nut points; this uses heat-set inserts because a nut trap needs the inside face (gear zone). Spacing kept at the upstream 8.1 mm. Reversible [A]

upstream_pattern_for_reference.flange_holes: 2x dia 3.3 (M3 clearance), centres 8.1 mm apart, dia 5.4 x 2 counterbores, 4 mm flange

bracket.riser: 12 x 3 mm web from the flange up +n to the camera plate's low edge

wrist_option.cable: Pi Camera: CSI ribbon ~906 mm lens -> Pi on the table vs official 200/300/500 mm [S]; ribbon twist through +-150 deg roll not assessed. If the wrist camera must survive wrist roll, fit the 32 x 32 UVC instead (USB, see usb_alternative)

csi_run.roll_twist: a flat-flex ribbon through +-150 deg wrist roll in a 60-80 mm loop is not assessed and is not a rated use [A]; the USB 32 x 32 UVC (round cable) avoids both the length and the twist problem
